settings.question: Who is this for?
settings.answer: Children aged 12–18, across all boards — CBSE, ICSE, IB, IGCSE. The assessment is most impactful for children in Grades 6–12, when profile-building decisions are actively being made.

settings.question: Is this an IQ or aptitude test?
settings.answer: No. This is a Multiple Intelligence and 6 Quotients assessment — it maps the different ways your child thinks and learns across 8 intelligences and 6 Quotients.

settings.question: What are the 6 Quotients?
settings.answer: The 6 Quotients measure your child across different domains like EQ, Vision, experiential understanding, creativity, handling adversity and digital knowledge — dimensions of how your child engages with the world that a standard aptitude test doesn't capture.

settings.question: How long does the test take?
settings.answer: Around 20–25 minutes, taken online in a live proctored session with a neOwn team member present.

settings.question: What does the counselling session look like?
settings.answer: A 1-hour Zoom session with the expert — the first 30 minutes with you as a parent, the second 30 minutes with your child in the meeting.

settings.question: When do I receive the report?
Can I reschedule?
settings.answer: One free reschedule is allowed if requested at least 24 hours before the slot. Rescheduling within 24 hours of the slot is not permitted

settings.question: Will I get a refund if I cancel?
settings.answer: Full refund if cancelled at least 24 hours before your test slot. No refund once the test has been taken.

settings.question: Can I buy the add-on sessions without the base plan?
settings.answer: No. The 2-session and 4-session add-on packs are only available to parents who have completed the base assessment.

settings.question: Can I book this for two children?
settings.answer: Yes. Each child requires a separate booking.
